bool_coercion_reference.scope: Public SDK AppTest with raw WidgetStates: all oneof fields plus absent value, fixed four checkbox/toggle defaults and peer. Submit/ID-only/recover; callbacks and stable IDs. Valid standard JSON only; no malformed/nonfinite JSON, disabled, browser or SDK socket claim.
bool_coercion_reference.source:
import streamlit as st
keys=['cb0','cb1','tg0','tg1']
if 'calls' not in st.session_state:st.session_state.calls=[]
def changed(source):
 def callback():st.session_state.calls.append([source,*[st.session_state[key] for key in keys],st.session_state.peer])
 return callback
values=[]
for key,kind,default in [('cb0','checkbox',False),('cb1','checkbox',True),('tg0','toggle',False),('tg1','toggle',True)]:
 values.append(getattr(st,kind)(key,value=default,key=key,on_change=changed(key)))
values.append(st.text_input('peer',value='base',key='peer',on_change=changed('peer')))
st.json({'values':values,'calls':st.session_state.calls})

bool_disabled_reference.scope: Public SDK AppTest: previous disabled metadata, transient callback values, keyed declaration-default changes, enabling, editing, disabling and recovery. All existing 44 valid wire inputs; malformed/nonfinite JSON excluded. No socket/browser/full protobuf claim.
bool_disabled_reference.source:
import streamlit as st
keys=['cb0','cb1','tg0','tg1']
if 'calls' not in st.session_state:st.session_state.calls=[]
def changed(source):
 def callback():st.session_state.calls.append([source,*[st.session_state[key] for key in keys],st.session_state.peer])
 return callback
phase=st.session_state.get('peer','base')
disabled=phase not in ('enable','edit','recover')
flipped=phase not in ('base','submit','recover')
values=[]
for key,kind,default in [('cb0','checkbox',False),('cb1','checkbox',True),('tg0','toggle',False),('tg1','toggle',True)]:
 values.append(getattr(st,kind)(key,value=not default if flipped else default,key=key,disabled=disabled,on_change=changed(key)))
values.append(st.text_input('peer',value='base',key='peer',on_change=changed('peer')))
st.json({'values':values,'calls':st.session_state.calls})
